title: Director, PXT - Amazon Leo Production Operations
text:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon has committed more than $10 billion to Amazon Leo, a low Earth orbit satellite network designed to bring fast, affordable broadband to customers around the world. Production Operations is where that ambition becomes physical. Every Leo satellite weighs more than 1,000 pounds, contains roughly 4 million individual components, and is designed and built in-house on a 172,000 square foot custom production line in Kirkland, Washington, capable of producing up to five satellite a day. The team completed its 1,000th satellite in September 2026 (https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-builds-satellites), making Leo one of the largest and most advanced satellite production operations in the world. 
From the factory, satellites move to a 100,000 square foot payload processing facility at Kennedy Space Center in Florida that can support three launch campaigns at once, and to launch operations in French Guiana. With more than 80 launches secured across four launch providers, Leo plans to double its launch rate to more than 20 missions in its second year. The organization spans eight sites today across multiple states and ground stations across multiple countries, with more investments coming through in the times ahead. 
This role builds on Amazon's deep operations heritage and takes it to newer heights. You will partner with an organization that brings together aerospace, RF, supply chain and manufacturing experts, recruited from the leading space and defense companies, alongside a skilled hourly production and launch workforce building and launching satellite in clean rooms, across shifts, and on mission-critical launch campaigns. Few people leaders anywhere get to shape all of this at once: precision satellite manufacturing across multiple satellite generations, export-controlled and government production, and Amazon Leo's first employing entity outside the US. 
The people decisions made in the next 18 months will shape this organization for the next decade. As the senior PXT leader for Production Operations, you will make them alongside the VP of Production Operations and the multiple Directors who lead satellite manufacturing, launch operations, supply chain, quality, ground gateways, global trade and compliance, enterprise technology, and Manufacturing Systems Engineering and New Product Introduction. You won't be inheriting a playbook. You'll be writing it. 
What makes this role unique 

* Two talent markets, one interwoven strategy. Build differentiated people programs for a highly technical corporate workforce competing in one of the most constrained talent markets in the world, and for a large, fast growing hourly manufacturing and launch workforce, under a single coherent people strategy.
* Organization design at a defining moment. Shape org design, leadership formation, and succession as the organization scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production in parallel, with a leadership team forming as it grows.
* People infrastructure Amazon has never built. Create job families, compensation, and career frameworks for roles Amazon has never hired before, people processes for export-controlled and cleared work, and Amazon Leo's first non-US employing entity at a launch site.
* Proactive employee and labor relations. Set a direct-engagement and labor relations strategy for an hourly workforce, across factories and launch sites in multiple states and countries.

 
Key job responsibilities 

* Serve as strategic people partner to the VP of Production Operations and Director-level function leaders, advising on organizational design, talent architecture, site strategy, and workforce planning across corporate technical and hourly populations.
* Shape the multi-year organization design for Production Operations as it scales across multiple satellite generations, direct-to-device, and government production, including new leadership roles and structures.
* Lead talent strategy for specialized technical roles (aerospace manufacturing, RF and telecommunications engineering, satellite quality, supply chain and trade compliance, AI and automation), competing against established aerospace and defense employers.
* Build scalable HR infrastructure for a 24/7 manufacturing and launch operation, including new-to-Amazon approaches to timekeeping, attendance, performance management, and shift support.
* Lead people strategy for Launch Operations, including sustainable staffing models for launch campaigns, rotational teams, off-shift coverage, and recurring travel.
* Set a proactive labor and employee relations strategy in partnership with Global Employee Relations and Labor Relations, coaching senior operations leaders on direct employee engagement at every site.
* Define people requirements for export-controlled and government manufacturing, including security clearances, cleared hiring pipelines, and compliant people processes, with Legal and Security.
* Stand up Amazon Leo's first non-US employee population at an international launch site, including employment contracts, compensation and benefits, payroll, and statutory compliance.
* Drive leadership development, calibration, promotion readiness, and succession planning across a rapidly expanding senior leadership bench.
* Build and lead a team of HR Business Partners, operating through a deep matrix across HR Partners, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, Talent Management, Employee Relations, PXT Technology, and international partners.

 
Click the link to see how Amazon’s growing constellation of custom-built satellites will work together to bring internet connectivity anywhere on the planet: https://www.aboutamazon.com/stories/how-amazon-leo-satellite-internet-works

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 15+ years of progressive human resources experience
* 10+ years of experience as an HR business partner supporting senior executives
* 7+ years of experience leading HR strategy for large-scale manufacturing, production, or operations organizations with hourly or shift-based workforces
* 5+ years of experience leading HR strategy for organizations operating across multiple countries and legal entities
* Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources or MBA
* Experience with employee and labor relations in union represented or union-exposed environments
* Experience designing organizational structures, compensation frameworks, and job architecture for large, fast-growing organizations
* Experience leading people strategy in aerospace, defense, satellite, telecommunications, or advanced manufacturing
* Experience supporting highly technical engineering populations alongside hourly production workforces
* Experience supporting launch, flight, field, or campaign-based operations with rotational or travel-intensive staffing
* Experience designing people processes for export-controlled (ITAR/EAR) or government cleared work environments
* Experience standing up new sites, greenfield operations, or new country employing entities
* Track record of building senior leadership teams and coaching executives through rapid organizational change
* Ability to thrive in ambiguity and to build mechanisms that scale beyond any single leader

 
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. 
 
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.
